name: Operational Cohesion Release 0.2.0
description: Consolidate policy, traceability, typed capabilities, tool isolation, and project/memory runtime predictability.

userStories.title: Create Policy Kernel facade
userStories.description: Create Pincer.Core.Policy facade with unified API.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Pincer.Core.Policy with allow?/2, route/2, budget/2, guard!/2, recover/2
Delegate to existing policy modules preserving behavior
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-001-create-policy-kernel-facade-r2. Files: lib/pincer/core/policy.ex, lib/pincer/core.ex, test/pincer/core/policy_test.exs. Facade API implemented (allow?/2, route/2, budget/2, guard!/2, recover/2) delegating to existing policies. Validated with mix test test/pincer/core/policy_test.exs, mix format --check-formatted, mix compile --warnings-as-errors.

userStories.title: Route sensitive decisions through Policy Kernel
userStories.description: Migrate sensitive decision points to facade.
acceptanceCriteria: Decision outputs include reason codes for trace
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-002-route-sensitive-decisions. Migrated sensitive decision callsites to Pincer.Core.Policy (DM allow checks, session scope routing, retry/fail-fast classification, retry-after budgeting, and empty-response recovery path). Added Policy.classify/2 plus integration test for reason-friendly outputs used by tracing.

userStories.title: Implement trace schema and storage
userStories.description: Create structured turn trace schema and persistence hooks.
acceptanceCriteria: Trace stores summarized tool and provider/model metadata
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-003-implement-trace-schema-storage-r2. Added Pincer.Core.Trace with typed step kinds and checkpoint metadata serialization. Exported Trace in Core boundary. Added trace_test coverage for envelope creation, step appending, and serialization.

userStories.title: Emit trace events from executor loop
userStories.description: Emit trace events for relevant turn lifecycle steps.
acceptanceCriteria: Emit events for prompt, policy, llm, tool, memory
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-004-emit-trace-events-executor. Executor now emits structured trace step events for prompt prep, policy decisions, LLM invocation, tool invocation/results, fallback/recovery, and terminal checkpoints when trace_events? is enabled. Added executor_trace_test to validate step emission and snapshot delivery.

userStories.title: Add replay mode without side effects
userStories.description: Add safe replay from stored trace.
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-005-add-replay-without-side-effects. Added Pincer.Core.TraceReplay with deterministic no-side-effects replay from stored trace steps. Supports stop_at: :tool_boundary and reports replay metadata (steps_replayed, stopped_at, executed_tools=[]). Added trace_replay_test coverage for full replay and boundary stop. Validated with mix format --check-formatted, mix compile --warnings-as-errors, and mix test --warnings-as-errors test/pincer/core/trace_replay_test.exs.

userStories.title: Define formal capability schema
acceptanceCriteria: Query API by adapter type and feature
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-006-define-formal-capability-schema. Added Pincer.Core.Capabilities with explicit schema_version/0 ("1.0"), validation API by adapter type (provider/tool/channel) with structured missing-field errors, and query/2 API filtering catalog entries by type + feature. Added test coverage in capabilities_test.exs for versioning, validation success/failure, and query behavior. Validated with mix test test/pincer/core/capabilities_test.exs, mix format, and mix compile --warnings-as-errors.

userStories.title: Implement capability declarations for adapters
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-007-implement-capability-declarations-adapters. Extended Pincer.Core.Capabilities with explicit declarations/1 catalog for provider/tool/channel adapters and schema-validated capability payloads. Added representative provider declarations (openrouter, google), tool declarations (safe_shell, web, file_system) including risk metadata, and channel declarations (telegram, discord, cli) with UX/streaming fields. Expanded capabilities_test to verify declarations existence and schema validity. Validated with mix format, mix test test/pincer/core/capabilities_test.exs, and mix compile --warnings-as-errors.
